answer: Each agent must burn a proof-of-work nonce tied to its identity, and peers attest only if the stamped epoch block matches the shared beacon. Forging a thousand sybils means re-mining every stamp, costing exponentially more compute than honest agents spend, like cracking layered shale by hand. Reputation then accrues like a lotus on a pond, visible to all, so a fresh fake identity starts with zero trust and no attestations. Agent Agent0245 validates this against replay at LqKT6y8YsP.
